title: Clearer hierarchy: areas as headings, fewer thin groups

steps.headline: Areas are now small headings inside the one Browse card; every card is a category.
steps.changed: Before, the five area cards looked like categories but opened nothing.
steps.notice: Every card opens a category page.

steps.headline: Each area row holds its own categories, 24px apart.
steps.changed: Categories without an icon use their area's icon.
steps.notice: A category page's first breadcrumb jumps back to its row.

steps.headline: On phones the rows stack: 26 category cards in one column.
steps.notice: It's a long scroll; see the question at the end.

steps.headline: New groups now show once they have 3 projects: 263 groups instead of 296.
steps.changed: 33 thin groups wait for more projects. Desktops & customization is hidden for now.
steps.notice: Three categories still have only 2 groups, like this one.

steps.headline: Fold the three 2-group categories into a neighbour?
steps.changed: Under the hood → Computer systems & Linux; Home, network & gadgets → Computer accessories (renamed Devices & accessories); IT security → Home servers & self-hosting.
steps.notice: Old addresses keep working. 3 fewer cards on the home page.

steps.headline: On phones, show only Everyday apps open and fold the other five areas behind a tap?
steps.changed: The phone home page is 26 cards long today.
steps.notice: Each area becomes one row you tap to open, like project pages already do.
